definitions.probability_measure: dF=K(tau)dtau/H0 on tau>=0; H0>0; no direct heat at tau=0; finite-operator exponential density has no atom at T
definitions.early_conditional: divide early raw moments by p; variance=second-mean^2
definitions.tail_conditional: divide tail raw moments by 1-p; variance=second-mean^2
definitions.early_and_tail_variance: law of total variance for early/tail conditional distributions
definitions.model_difference: raw difference fullBED-legacy and signed relative (fullBED-legacy)/legacy where legacy nonzero; empirical model comparison, no uncertainty distribution
definitions.active_operator: A=-G[:n,:n], upper triangular, positive diagonal, nonpositive offdiagonal; active block is dimensionless in u=t/T0. Complete G includes mixed ledger units.
definitions.heat_row: h=G[heat,:n] scaled to u; normalized energy coordinates
definitions.adjoint: A.T q0=h; A.T q1=q0; A.T q2=q1
definitions.residence_contribution: per-state contribution T0*q0_i*w_ij to unnormalized H1_j; sum exactly H1_j mathematically; normalize H0_j for seconds
definitions.residual_residence_contribution: T0*q0_i*v_ij to unnormalized tail excess first moment; normalize Htail_j for remaining conditional seconds
definitions.source_energy_tail_at_T: q0_i*xT_ij gives eventual tail heat associated with active energy coordinate at T; distinct from residence weighting and heat deposition energy
definitions.bins: (lo,hi] right-closed partitions of saved E; all states exactly once; label numeric edges, no atomic-threshold interpretation

invariants: All prior source, atomic identities, gas, cutoffs, source normalization, precision, quadrature, accumulation order and physical G constructor preserved.
Only new diagnostic representation; no evolution beyond T, long-tail sampling, physical source history change, or G modification.
No rate, heat, count, or tail clipping. Retain signed residuals; a tolerance does not replace values.
Old PHYS02D failed attempt and consumed PHYS02E successful one-shot retained; no retry authorization reuse.

validation.scalar_finite_positive: Reject nonfinite, negative yield, nonpositive T, incompatible moments beyond frozen tolerances; exact zero-probability events return UNDEFINED_ZERO_EVENT_PROBABILITY without NaN or division.
validation.exact_fraction: Exact rational tests of censoring, event decomposition, mixture total variance, zero-probability edges; no shared implementation oracle.
validation.no_silent_negative_variance: Raw negative variance retained; std null plus typed issue unless an actually positive variance exists; significant negative fails.
validation.operator_match: Before any resolvent reservation compare exact CSC shape, nnz, all three raw array SHA256s, saved E and parent method object identity to PR35 completed G. Mismatch typed OPERATOR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; no fallback, no solves.
validation.graph_structure: Check Metzler active block, exact upper triangularity, negative active diagonal, nonnegative heat row, absorbing ledgers; never solve full generator.
validation.adjoint_oracle: Small <=8 active states; exact Fraction upper triangular reference and independent forward/adjoint identity, optional analytic density integrals. Test q0, q1, q2, w, v and bin partition.
validation.scope: Physical checks in NCP are same-operator identities and mechanistic diagnostic of named9600 only; neither independent physical validation nor mesh convergence.
